## HubSpot Contact Sync to Sheets
Scheduled sync of HubSpot CRM contacts to Google Sheets with email diff reports.

**Setup:**
1. Set HubSpot API key in HTTP Header Auth (Bearer token)
2. Connect Google Sheets with your contacts spreadsheet
3. Configure Gmail for sync reports
4. Adjust schedule frequency as needed (default: every 6 hours)
